module: HPE FlexNetwork MSR1000, MSR2000, MSR3000 and MSR4000 Router Series
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with tamper labels installed as indicated in the Security Policy
description: The HPE Networking devices are suitable for a range of uses: at the edge of a network, connecting server clusters in a data center, in an enterprise LAN core, and in large-scale industrial networks and campus networks. Each device is based on the HPE Comware Software, Version 7.1.045 platform.
